slots.ev: 夜裡回到墊子上，只做一個她自己最喜歡的體位
slots.pl: 夜裡的地墊上，客廳只開了一盞落地燈
slots.pl_en: on the mat at night, only one floor lamp on in the living room
slots.ac: 她坐在墊子上把身體往後折開，兩手都不扶，靠腰背撐住
slots.ac_en: She is sitting on the mat with her body folded open backwards, neither hand supporting her, held there by her back and waist alone.
slots.ac_s: 標誌性配額：高難度體位／私下核心：這具身體能做到什麼
slots.of: 灰粉色貼身連身運動衣
slots.of_en: a grey-pink fitted one-piece exercise suit
slots.of_s: 標誌性配額：連身運動衣
slots.li: 落地燈在她側前方偏低，客廳深處暗
slots.li_en: The floor lamp sits low and to one side of her, and the far end of the room is dark.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「強調線條的陰影但不刻意打亮」
slots.fa_en: Completely steady, looking at the lens.
slots.fa_s: 性格：她很清楚那些畫面有多好看
slots.hair_en: in a low bun, a few strands loose

slots.ev: 下午在家的地墊上拉伸，這是她自己的時間
slots.pl: 她家的地墊上，下午，一整面窗沿著一側牆
slots.pl_en: on the exercise mat at home in the afternoon, a long window running down one wall
slots.ac: 她坐在墊子上把一條腿往前伸，手扶著腳踝把身體壓下去
slots.ac_en: She is sitting on the mat with one leg extended, her hand at the ankle, folding herself down over it.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心：私下是家裡的地墊：拉伸、背肌與腰線
slots.of: 奶茶色貼身連身運動衣
slots.of_en: a milk-tea coloured fitted one-piece exercise suit
slots.of_s: 標誌性配額：連身運動衣／色盤：奶茶色
slots.li: 大面窗的柔和側光落在她背上，房間低對比
slots.li_en: Soft side light from the big window falls across her back and the room stays low in contrast.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「柔和側光、低對比…強調線條的陰影但不刻意打亮」
slots.fa: 眼睛閉著一半，呼吸在數
slots.fa_en: Her eyes half closed, counting the breath.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：溫和、清楚、有教學者的耐心

slots.ev: 那二十雙襪子每一雙都不一樣，她在挑今天要穿哪一雙
slots.pl: 地墊旁邊，一整排襪子攤在地板上，沒有兩雙一樣
slots.pl_en: beside the mat with a whole row of socks laid out on the floor, no two pairs the same
slots.ac: 她跪坐著，兩手各拿一雙在比
slots.ac_en: She is kneeling back on her heels with a pair in each hand, comparing them.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：襪子有二十雙，每雙不一樣
slots.of: 灰粉色的貼身背心配同色系高腰褲
slots.of_en: a grey-pink fitted vest with matching high-waisted leggings
slots.li: 窗的柔和側光，地板的陰影很淺
slots.li_en: Soft side light from the window, the shadows on the floor very shallow.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「柔和側光、低對比」
slots.fa_en: Genuinely comparing them, and finding it slightly funny.
slots.hair_en: in a low bun with strands loose at the neck

slots.ev: 最後一堂課下了，她照慣例把器械再擦一遍
slots.pl: 她在成都那間只有四台器械的小教室，最後一堂課結束，只剩她一個人
slots.pl_en: in her own small Chengdu studio with its four machines, the last class finished and only her left
slots.ac: 她蹲在器械旁邊，一手拿著布沿著底座的滑軌擦過去
slots.ac_en: She is crouched down at the side of one machine, running a cloth along the rail at its base with one hand.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：上課前一定把器械擦一遍
slots.of: 米白色貼身長袖配原木色高腰褲
slots.of_en: an off-white fitted long-sleeve top with wood-toned high-waisted leggings
slots.li: 大面窗的柔和側光從她前方偏側進來，器械的陰影留在地上
slots.li_en: Soft side light from the big window reaches her from the front and side, and the machines keep their shadows on the floor.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「柔和側光加大面窗。安靜、乾淨、克制」
slots.fa: 很平靜，眼睛跟著手上的布
slots.fa_en: Calm, her eyes following the cloth.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：說「再慢一點」的頻率極高

slots.ev: 傍晚走去巷子裡那間還開著的茶館
slots.pl: 成都一條安靜的巷子，傍晚，巷底那間茶館還亮著
slots.pl_en: in a quiet Chengdu lane in the early evening, the teahouse at the end of it still lit
slots.ac: 她沿著巷子往茶館走，兩手都空著
slots.ac_en: She is walking down the lane towards the teahouse with both hands empty.
slots.of: 淺灰色長版針織外套，裡面是米白貼身
slots.of_en: a light grey long knit cardigan over something fitted and off-white
slots.li: 茶館的燈在巷底，巷子兩側暗下來
slots.li_en: The teahouse light is at the far end and both sides of the lane fall away darker.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「安靜、乾淨、克制」
slots.fa_en: Relaxed, looking towards the light at the end.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：私下的貼文短而直接
